nano_avoid: Avoid any lending app NOT on the SECP whitelist — check the exact app name and the developer company name against the list. Barwaqt was delisted in Aug 2024, the QisstPay app was removed in Jul 2024, and KalPay is not whitelisted. Never install a loan app from an APK file, a Facebook ad or a shared link; never pay a fee before approval; never let an app read your contacts or photos. A 'personal micro-loan' repayable in 3, 7 or 14 days is illegal — the regulated minimum tenure is 30 days.

nano_guardrails.apr_cap_note: APR at most 10× the SBP policy rate (= 120% a year at the current 12% policy rate)
nano_guardrails.note: SECP nano-loan caps from Circular 15 of 2022 and Circular 10 of 2023, as reported by Which.pk (updated 19 Oct 2026). Whether these caps survived the Nov 2025 amendments (SRO 2120(I)/2025) is UNCONFIRMED — treat them as the published guardrails, not as a guarantee.
nano_guardrails.total_cost_cap: Total cost (all fees + interest + late penalties) at most equal to the loan itself (principal)
